id: Kudaki punggung beringin, dan Ciung turun bersama telurnya yang aneh.
en: I climbed the banyan ridge and Ciung came down with his strange egg.

en: The stall-keeper said a tall man in a blank mask was asking children's names.

id: Semar bilang nama yang ditulis menahan seseorang di dunia, dan Cepot ribut soal lampu.
en: Semar said a written name keeps a person in the world, and Cepot fussed about the lamps.

id: Laras menulis nama kami di kedua ujung satu lontar, dengan pena bambu Semar.
en: Laras wrote our names at opposite ends of one lontar, with Semar's bamboo pen.

id: Kami menyalakan empat lampu di sekeliling panggung saat senja turun.
en: We lit four lamps around the stage as dusk fell.

en: Semar played the ruwatan: Batara Kala, the Four Seals, and the children's names read aloud.

id: Bayangan turun dari kelir. Si Pemburu membawa Laras, dan lontar kami robek.

id: Di kebun teh kupatahkan penyergapan dan kutemukan pita Laras di rumpun bambu.
en: On the tea terraces I broke an ambush and found Laras's ribbon in the bamboo.

id: Kubersihkan perkemahan pengintai Tanpa Rupa. Daftar mereka dicoret, tapi nama Laras tidak.
en: I cleared the Faceless scout camp. Their lists were crossed out, but Laras's name was not.

id: Di petilasan Cepot menemukanku. Ia tak ingat Laras, tapi ia percaya ayahnya.
en: At the petilasan Cepot found me. He doesn't remember Laras, but he believes his father.

id: Kupatahkan serangan di kampung, babi hutan dan para topeng sekaligus.
en: I broke the raid on the kampung, boars and masks together.

en: The kampung elder saw Laras running with a wild boy. He taught me Ga.

id: Ceu Imas kehilangan putranya, Asep, saat maghrib. Kutemukan sandalnya di tepi sungai.
en: Ceu Imas lost her son Asep at maghrib. I found his sandal by the river.

id: Obor-obor padam, dan jejak Laras, Ciung dan anak-anak menuju ngarai.
en: The torches were cold, and the prints of Laras, Ciung and the children led into the gorge.

id: Kunyalakan kembali lentera luar dusun, dan kabut senja berhenti di cahayanya.
en: I relit the hamlet's outer lanterns, and the dusk mist stopped at their light.

id: Lontar menarikku ke maghrib seorang anak, dan aku belajar menyalakan oncor.
en: The lontar pulled me into a child's maghrib, and I learned to light the oncor.

id: Kukalahkan Sandekala di ngarai. Jejak Laras dan Ciung berpisah di sana.
en: I beat Sandekala in the gorge. Laras's and Ciung's tracks split there.

id: Kutegakkan tiga batu nama dalam satu garis, dari timur ke barat, dan kubersihkan hutan di sekitarnya.
en: I stood three name-stones in a line, east to west, and cleared the grove around them.

id: Di Batu Tulis yang dirusak Laras menggores: "Mereka butuh aku membaca." Kupelajari Nga.
en: On the defaced Batu Tulis Laras scratched: "They need me to read." I learned Nga.

id: Dari teras kulihat lembah setengah tenggelam oleh bendungan yang dibangun semalam.
en: From the terraces I saw the valley half drowned by a dam built overnight.

id: Kuusir para tanpa rupa dan jurig hutan dari teras sawah Penenun.
en: I drove the faceless and the forest spirits off the Weaver's terraces.

id: Kubuka pintu air. Penenun menyembunyikan Laras semalam dan memberiku Boeh Rarang.
en: I opened the sluices. The Weaver hid Laras for a night and gave me the Boeh Rarang.

id: Di keramaian sayembara Galuh kutemui penjual ayam jago, dan Ciung serta aku menyusun rencana.
en: In Galuh's tournament crowd I met a rooster seller, and Ciung and I made a plan.

id: Di Pasar Kuta seorang pemberi kabar bercerita tentang pedati bersegel lilin raja. Daftar angkutan menyebut muatannya pelayan baru.
en: At Pasar Kuta an informant told me of wagons sealed with the king's wax. The freight list called their load new servants.

id: Kubongkar para pengatur curang sayembara di gudang. Kantong mereka bersegel sama dengan pedati.
en: I broke the tournament riggers in the storehouse. Their purses wore the same seal as the wagons.

id: Kumenangkan kedua babak; ayam Ciung menang di balik tembok.
en: I won both bouts; Ciung's rooster won behind the wall.

id: Uwa Lengser membuka istana dalam. Ia melihat mata seorang ratu pada Ciung.
en: Uwa Lengser opened the inner palace. He saw a queen's eyes in Ciung.

id: Di Balai Pustaka, Nyai Sekar bercerita bahwa ia mengerik silsilah raja dari tiga puluh gulung dan menyimpan serpihannya.
en: In the Balai Pustaka, Nyai Sekar told me she scraped the king's lineage off thirty rolls and kept the shavings.

id: Cahaya cermin menampakkan silsilah yang dikerik. Nama yang hilang adalah Nagawiru.
en: Mirror-light raised the scraped lineage. The missing name was Nagawiru.

id: Kuseberangi serambi menuju Kaputren. Sebuah cermin di sana pun tertutup.
en: I crossed the colonnade into the Kaputren. A mirror stood covered there too.

id: Di kamar tamu kutemukan tusuk rambut Laras dan Ka yang digoresnya seperti anak tangga.
en: In the guest chamber I found Laras's hairpin and her Ka scratched like steps.

id: Di pasar sungai dua perekrut menceritakan perang yang sama secara terbalik, dan batu tumbuh di ladang di luar gerbang.
en: At the river market two recruiters told the same war backwards, and stones grew in the fields beyond the gate.

id: Kupatahkan blokade penjarah di gerbang perbatasan dan beristirahat di petilasan.
en: I broke the looters' blockade at the border gate and rested at the petilasan.

id: Kuselamatkan panggung seorang dalang dari penjarah perang dan Tuyul.
en: I saved a dalang's stage from war-profiteers and Tuyul.

id: Ki Sumarto mengajariku Ha dan menyebut tiga jejak menuju Laras: reruntuhan, kuburan, dan pelataran lesung.
en: Ki Sumarto taught me Ha and named three trails to Laras: the ruins, the graveyard and the lesung yard.

id: Kukawal keluarga pasar melintasi sawah tergenang. Anak-anak mereka melihat Ka Laras.
en: I led the market families over the flooded paddies. Their children had seen Laras's Ka.

id: Di reruntuhan kukalahkan Arca yang bangkit dan kubaca Na dari dasar patung.
en: At the ruins I beat the awakened Arca and read Na off the statue base.

id: Di kuburan si Pemburu bilang dua pasukan membuat dua kali lupa.
en: At the graves the Hunter said two armies make twice the forgetting.

id: Pecahan topeng ketiga menunjukkan harga namanya.
en: A third mask fragment showed what his name cost.

id: Nyai Gendhis dan aku membersihkan pelataran lesung, dan alu-alu dikembalikan.
en: Nyai Gendhis and I cleared the lesung yard, and the pestles were handed back.

id: Nyai Gendhis mengajariku irama fajar palsu dan Ca.
en: Nyai Gendhis taught me the false-dawn rhythm and Ca.

id: Kupatahkan kepungan para pembangun malam di kuil kaki bukit.
en: I broke the night builders' siege on the foothill shrine.

id: Kuselaraskan tungku kuil, dan juru kunci memberiku Ra serta membuka tangga candi.
en: I aligned the shrine's braziers, and the juru kunci gave me Ra and opened the temple stairs.

id: Kuhancurkan pilar-pilar di dataran batu yang tumbuh.
en: I shattered the pillars on the plain of rising stones.

id: Di jalan para pandai besi kutemui Ratna, yang melipat keris. Ia memberiku tiga paku penangkal api dan menyuruhku beristirahat.
en: On the smiths' street I met Ratna, who folds keris. She gave me three fire-ward nails and sent me to rest.

id: Raksasa hijau, Buto Ijo, menerjangku dari rumput. Paku-paku itu mendorongnya mundur, dan matanya semerah kutukan.
en: A green giant, Buto Ijo, charged me out of the grass. The nails drove him back, and his eyes were the red of the curse.

id: Tanda kutukan merah membawaku ke Mpu Wirasana. Ia empu ketujuh yang merawat bilah yang ditempa untuk menelan.
en: Red curse marks led me to Mpu Wirasana. He is the seventh smith to tend a blade made to swallow.

id: Di halamannya kupadamkan dua tonggak latihan dengan Ha. Tanda itu hutang, dan Ha melunasinya perlahan.
en: At his yard I put out two practice stakes with Ha. A mark is a debt, and Ha pays it down.

id: Mbok Srini kehilangan putrinya, Timun Mas, pada raksasa itu. Kutemukan biji, tempat jarum, garam dan terasi.
en: Mbok Srini lost her daughter Timun Mas to the giant. I found the seeds, the needle case, the salt and the terasi.

id: Di dasar sungai kering, bungkusan biji menumbuhkan semak berduri dan menahan Buto Ijo sepuluh napas.
en: On the dry riverbed the seed pouch grew brambles and held Buto Ijo for ten breaths.

id: Di beringin tua kusucikan bungkusan-bungkusan itu saat raksasa datang ketiga kali. Ia ditaruh di jalan kami.
en: At the old banyan I consecrated the pouches while the giant came a third time. He was being placed in our road.

id: Lontar menarikku menjadi Timun Mas yang lari dari raksasa dengan empat bungkusan.
en: The lontar pulled me into Timun Mas running from a giant with four pouches.

id: Kupancing Buto Ijo melewati empat medan bungkusan dan kukalahkan. Mbok Srini memeluk putrinya yang berlumpur.
en: I led Buto Ijo through the four pouch fields and beat him. Mbok Srini held her muddy daughter.

id: Tonggak merah muncul di ladang kering, masing-masing bernama. Kupadamkan satu per satu.
en: Red stakes rose in the dry fields, each with a name. I put them out one by one.

id: Dua puluh tiga keris hantu menerjang bengkel. Wirasana, Ratna dan aku menjaga kampung tempa.
en: Twenty-three ghost keris flew at the forge. Wirasana, Ratna and I held the quarter.

id: Pasukan Hariang Banga menurunkanku di Desa Purwa di bawah Gerhana. Kabut di mulut gua memakan setiap huruf yang kulempar.
en: Hariang Banga's riders set me down in Desa Purwa under the Eclipse. The fog at the cave mouth ate every glyph I threw.

id: Pasangan tua dan penjaga lapak mulai lupa keluarga sendiri. Mereka menyebut tiga rumah yang paling parah.
en: The old couple and the stall-keeper are forgetting their own families. They named three houses worst.

id: Kutuliskan nama tiga keluarga di tiang pintu mereka, dan rumah-rumah itu ingat.
en: I wrote three families' names on their doorposts, and the houses remembered.

id: Kubawakan Ibu pita, papan, dan helai Ka milik Laras. Ia menata cangkir kedua dengan benar.
en: I brought Ibu Laras's ribbon, board and Ka strip. She set the second cup straight.

id: Ciung dan Hariang makan di meja ibuku sebagai saudara.
en: Ciung and Hariang ate at my mother's table as brothers.

id: Aria Kebonan bilang Kala memakan nama, dan nama Laras dipecah tiga. Ia minta dilupakan.
en: Aria Kebonan told me Kala eats names, and Laras's is split in three. He asked to be forgotten.

id: Semar bilang ia dewa yang memilih menjadi abdi, dan menyuruhku ke selatan, ke laut.
en: Semar told me he is a god who chose to be a servant, and sent me south to the sea.

id: Gerbang selatan terbuka ke pasir hitam dan laut hijau.
en: The south gate opened onto black sand and a green sea.

id: Di pantai pasir hitam aku beristirahat di petilasan, dan Kampung Nelayan menambal jala dalam diam.
en: On the black-sand shore I rested at the petilasan, and Kampung Nelayan mended its nets in silence.

id: Mbah Wiryo mengajariku tata krama laut dan tiga ujian suci. Sari, sang penyelam, menawarkan diri memandu.
en: Mbah Wiryo taught me the sea's manners and the three sacred trials. Sari, the diver, offered to guide me.

id: Kukumpulkan tiga bait lagu laut dari tiga keluarga.
en: I gathered three verses of the sea song from three families.

id: Lontar menunjukkan istri Wiryo mengajarinya memanggil nama ke dalam air.
en: The lontar showed Wiryo's wife teaching him to call a name into the water.

id: Di Pelataran Waktu kubergabung dengan Ciung dan Hariang, dan bersama kami mematahkan gelombang bayangan pertama.
en: At the Courtyard of Time I joined Ciung and Hariang, and together we broke the first shadow tide.

id: Di Batu Leluhur kutentukan apa yang terjadi pada nama Aria Kebonan.
en: At the ancestors' stone I chose what would become of Aria Kebonan's name.

id: Kubelah tirai Gerhana dengan Ombak dan bertempur masuk ke mulut gua.
en: I parted the Eclipse veil with Ombak and fought into the cave mouth.

id: Kuputar ulang kejar-kejaran dan merebut La.
en: I replayed the tag game and won back La.

id: Kuhancurkan dua penangkal waktu di Pasir Jam Pasir.
en: I shattered two time-wards on the Hourglass Sands.

id: Di Hutan Lupa kutenangkan pepohonan yang membisikkan nama curian.
en: In Hutan Lupa I silenced the trees that whisper stolen names.

id: Di Jurang Lupa kuputar ulang dua cangkir dan merebut Ra.
en: In the Abyss of Forgetting I replayed the two cups and won back Ra.

id: Di Jembatan Bayang kukalahkan gema legenda yang pernah kuhadapi.
en: On the Shadow Bridge I beat the echoes of the legends I had faced.

id: Di petilasan terakhir Semar menjaga apinya, dan kuputar ulang nama-nama yang ditulis dan merebut Sa.
en: At the last petilasan Semar kept his fire, and I replayed the written names and won back Sa.

en: A faceless one dropped a named toy. They were people once.

id: Perempuan di danau mengenali wajah Ciung. Ia memintaku menjaga rahasianya, dan mengajariku Ca.
en: The woman at the lake knew Ciung's face. She asked me to keep her secret, and taught me Ca.

id: Kutempuh jalan kawah sambil bertempur. Sosok jangkung di punggung bukit mengawasi, dan menunggu.
en: I fought up the crater road. A tall shape on the ridge watched, and waited.

id: Di kawah Laras dipaksa membaca. Ia sengaja membaca pelan, dan aku mendengar suaranya.
en: At the crater Laras was made to read. She read slowly on purpose, and I heard her voice.

id: Kukalahkan Kapten Tanpa Rupa, tapi ia sempat memecahkan segel. Kutemukan pecahan topeng kedua.
en: I beat the Faceless Captain, but he cracked the seal first. I found a second mask fragment.

id: Lontar menarikku ke malam Dayang Sumbi: kain putih, lesung, fajar palsu.
en: The lontar pulled me into Dayang Sumbi's night: white cloth, lesung, a false dawn.

id: Fajar palsu mengakhiri Sangkuriang sekali lagi. Ciung dan Nagawiru bebas, dan aku memilih apa yang kuberitahukan pada Ciung.
en: A false dawn ended Sangkuriang again. Ciung and Nagawiru are free, and I chose what to tell Ciung.

id: Kudengar seorang pangeran dan para dayang ratu: sebuah pedati menunggu di halaman penjara untuk berangkat saat fajar.
en: I overheard a prince and the queen's attendants: a wagon waited in the prison yard to leave at dawn.

id: Kutempuh tangga sel mengejar pedati, mengikuti bekas roda dan kain melati.
en: I fought down the cell stairs after the wagon, following wheel ruts and jasmine cloth.

id: Aku terlambat: kereta Laras lolos ke timur, tapi ia melempar helai bertanda Ka.
en: I was too late: Laras's wagon escaped east, but she threw me a strip marked Ka.

id: Di dinding sel Laras menulis: "Seribu candi. Jangan berhenti."
en: On the cell wall Laras wrote: "The thousand temples. Don't stop."

id: Kualami jam-jam Laras: ia menandai lilin raja, membuka jeruji arsip, dan menitip pesan untuk Ibu soal cangkir.
en: I lived Laras's hours: she marked the king's wax, freed the archive grate and left a message for Ibu about the cup.

id: Si pembelot ingat namanya, Ranga, dari ikut bersenandung bersama Laras. Kuputuskan nasibnya.
en: The deserter remembered his name, Ranga, from humming along to Laras. I decided what became of him.

id: Jeruji Laras membawaku menembus tembok arsip ke galeri atas istana.
en: Laras's grate led me through the archive wall to the palace's upper gallery.

id: Potret raja dikikis habis. Ingatan Lengser menunjukkan seorang lelaki mencoba wajah raja.
en: The king's portrait was scraped bare. Lengser's memory showed a man trying on the king's face.

id: Pecahan topeng kedua tergeletak di dekat takhta. Aria meminjam wajah raja, dan harganya namanya sendiri.
en: A second mask fragment lay by the throne. Aria borrowed the king's face, and the price was his name.

id: Penjaga lama Lengser dan Ciung berkumpul untuk mendobrak ruang takhta.
en: Lengser's old guard and Ciung gathered to breach the throne room.

id: Kubuka topeng Barma Wijaya. Ia mengaku memberikan namanya yang dulu pada Kala, dan nama itu si Pemburu.
en: I unmasked Barma Wijaya. He confessed he gave his old name to Kala, and that name is the Hunter.

id: Perkemahan di Candi Seribu ternyata ruang baca. Laras sudah dibawa ke timur.
en: The camp at Candi Seribu was a reading room. Laras had been taken east.

id: Puing, lesung yang ditinggalkan, helai Ka Laras: semuanya menunjuk satu kisah lama.
en: Rubble, an abandoned lesung, Laras's Ka strip: all pointed to one old tale.

id: Laras membaca pelan di ruang baca, membuka pintu ruang bawah tanah, dan menyembunyikan pahat si pembangun.
en: Laras read slowly in the reading room, freed a crypt door and hid the builder's chisel.

id: Pintu ruang bawah tanah Laras membawaku turun ke jantung candi.
en: Laras's crypt door led me down to the temple's heart.

id: Lontar menarikku ke para dayang sang putri, dan aku belajar irama lesung.
en: The lontar pulled me to the princess's women, and I learned the lesung beat.

id: Dengan irama dan Ca, malam Bandung Bondowoso berakhir.
en: With the beat and Ca, Bandung Bondowoso's night ended.

id: Jalan pintas candi membawaku kembali ke Pamali, tempat dua pasukan menunggu.
en: The temple shortcut brought me back to the Pamali, where two armies waited.

id: Di batu Pamali kutuliskan nama Nagawiru, nama pertama yang kutulis untuk orang lain.
en: On the Pamali stone I wrote Nagawiru's name, the first name I ever wrote for someone.

id: Ki Sumarto memainkan dua saudara yang membelah tanah, dan aku belajar arti pamali.
en: Ki Sumarto played two brothers who split the land, and I learned what pamali means.

id: Kubaca surat-surat Hariang Banga untuk ibunya.
en: I read Hariang Banga's letters to his mother.

id: Kulawan Hariang Banga di penyeberangan. Gencatan senjata sungai bertahan, dan kujawab Ciung soal para terkurung.
en: I fought Hariang Banga at the ford. The river truce held, and I answered Ciung about the caged.

id: Di gudang kutemukan sarung patah dan buku tujuh empu. Nama terakhirnya Wirasana.
en: In the vault I found the broken scabbard and the ledger of seven smiths. The last name was Wirasana's.

id: Di landasan tua aku menjadi murid yang melihat kutukan lahir, dan belajar memadamkannya.
en: At the old anvil I became the apprentice who saw the curse born, and learned to douse it.

id: Bersama pengintai Hariang Banga kuikuti jejak abu Si Pemburu menyusuri pesisir. Jejaknya lurus.
en: With Hariang Banga's scouts I followed the Hunter's ash trail down the coast. It runs straight.

id: Kuseberangi Lautan Pasir dengan patok kuno. Satu miring dengan sengaja.
en: I crossed the Sea of Sand by the old waymarkers. One leaned on purpose.

id: Di api unggun gurun Hariang Banga bicara tentang Ciung, ibunya, dan lelaki yang hanya punya rasa lelah.
en: At the desert fire Hariang Banga talked of Ciung, his mother and a man with only weariness.

id: Laras mencoba menggambar wajahku di pasir dan tak bisa. Ia membuka terowongan angin dan menulis Ka pada tonggak ketujuh.
en: Laras tried to draw my face in the sand and couldn't. She opened a wind tunnel and wrote Ka on the seventh stake.

id: Terowongannya membawaku ke belakang kuil. Di seberang pelataran kulihat ia membaca, dan tonggak ketujuh tak mau menyala.
en: Her tunnel brought me behind the shrine. Across the court I saw her reading, and the seventh stake would not light.

id: Kutenangkan keris yang bangkit. Tujuh tonggak padam, yang terakhir paling pelan.
en: I laid the awakened keris to rest. Seven stakes went out, the last one slowest.

id: Kuputuskan nasib bilah itu: bengkel Wirasana atau sungai.
en: I chose what to do with the blade: Wirasana's forge or the river.

id: Pecahan terakhir menunjukkan penyerbuan lewat mata si Pemburu. Pecahan-pecahan menyatu menjadi satu topeng.
en: The last fragment showed the raid through the Hunter's eyes. The fragments joined into one mask.

id: Kuhadapi si Pemburu dan kukembalikan nama Aria Kebonan. Lalu Gerhana mengambil Laras di tengah kata.
en: I faced the Hunter and gave back the name Aria Kebonan. Then the Eclipse took Laras mid-word.

id: Bersama Sari kunyalakan tiga suar pasang. Ia ingat bait kedua.
en: With Sari I lit the three tidal beacons. She remembered the second verse.

id: Kulalui ujian suci pertama dengan memadamkan Lampor di karang.
en: I passed the first sacred trial by putting out the Lampor on the reef.

id: Di Gua Karang dinding air hitam menghalangi jalan, dan sebuah lonceng berbunyi sekali.
en: In the Gua Karang a wall of black water barred the way, and a bell rang once.

id: Laras membunyikan tiga lonceng tenggelam dan laut menjawab. Gerbang air itu surut.
en: Laras rang three sunken bells and the sea answered. The water gate sank.

id: Kulalui ujian suci kedua, arus palung, tanpa mengejar kemenangan.
en: I passed the second sacred trial, the abyssal current, without chasing victory.

id: Di kuil tebing kudengar ratu selatan dituturkan sebagai satu kisah di antara banyak.
en: At the cliff shrine I heard the queen of the south told as one tale among many.

id: Kupanggil nama Laras ke laut dan memberi persembahanku. Jalan batu terbuka.
en: I called Laras's name to the sea and made my offering. The causeway opened.

id: Kususuri jalan batu laut ke Keraton Laut dan beristirahat.
en: I walked the sea causeway to the Sea Pavilion and rested.

id: Kulalui ujian suci ketiga, Ombak, dan sang ratu bicara sekali dari kejauhan.
en: I passed the third sacred trial, the Waves, and the queen spoke once from far away.

id: Kutulis Ombak di Altar Laut dan menerima Kain Hijau. Gua itu terbuka.
en: I wrote Ombak at the Sea Altar and received the Kain Hijau. The cave is open.

id: Semar menceritakan Murwakala: Kala lapar, bukan jahat.
en: Semar told the tale of Murwakala: Kala is hungry, not wicked.

id: Kuambil tempat dalang di kelir Semar dan membacakan nama-nama: Sunda, Jawa, dan Ombak.
en: I took the dalang's place at Semar's kelir and read the names, Sunda, Jawa and Ombak.

id: Laras di dasar kegelapan melupakanku, tapi tangannya masih menulis Ka, dan ia mulai meretakkan bayangan Kala.
en: Laras at the bottom of the dark forgot me, but her hand still wrote Ka, and she began to crack Kala's shadow.

id: Kutenangkan Batara Kala dengan Ruwatan Fajar sementara Laras memecahkan perisainya dari dalam.
en: I calmed Batara Kala with the Dawn Ruwatan while Laras broke his shield from inside.

id: Kutuliskan La-Ra-Sa, dan Laras pulang.
en: I wrote La-Ra-Sa, and Laras came home.
